title: EyeTrackingAnalysis: analysis code for visual-search and multiple-object-tracking eye-tracking experiments
description:
Reproducible analysis code for the behavioural eye-tracking study reported in the associated manuscript. It contains the feature extraction for the visual-search task, the search-performance analyses, the multiple-object-tracking (MOT) analyses and the combined expertise index, together with the full compute-environment definition (conda + R/pymer4) and a single entry point (run) that executes all notebooks and writes the result tables and figures.

Input data are deposited separately (see related identifiers) and are not part of this record.
notes: Environment: Python 3.10 + R 4.4 (conda-forge), see environment/. Tested on linux-64 and osx-64. Use `bash run` to regenerate every figure and table.
